description: The instance SSH private keys (GetSSHConfigResponse and InstanceExtendedMetadata.SshMetadata ssh_private_key), the Kubernetes client key (KubernetesInstanceMetadata.client_key_data) and GetKubernetesConfigResponse.kubeconfig carry no sensitive mark. The keys are `bytes`, base64 strings on the Connect-JSON wire, so the converter's name patterns do not see them. proto/namespace/cloud/compute/v1beta/compute.proto.
